capabilities: Render life-event Markdown entries on a monthly calendar with single-day pills and multi-day bars
Plot entries with coordinates on a MapLibre map with three free basemaps
Play an animated replay that flies a camera between stops over a date range
Create entries with geocoded locations via Nominatim or by dropping a map pin
Link the calendar and map views so hovering or clicking an entry highlights it in both
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. There is no settings page yet; future satellite imagery would require a MapTiler API key.
motivation: The author built it to make looking back at daily life enjoyable, after finding that existing tools split time and place across separate silos.
problem: Calendars, maps, and journals each track only part of when, where, and what happened, and cloud note apps keep personal life data on their servers.

relations.evidence: Odyssey will look it up via OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service
MapLibre GL JS vector tiles — fast, smooth, zero-configuration

summary: Life-event journal that renders Markdown entries with dates and coordinates as a monthly calendar, a map, and an animated replay.
